async def act(page):
    # Locate the row with status 'Canceled' in the table
    # Use the second rowgroup (index 1) which contains the data rows
    canceled_row = page.get_by_role('rowgroup').nth(1).get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Canceled', exact=True))
    
    # Extract the 'Bill-to Name' cell text (it's the 4th cell, index 3)
    bill_to_name_cell = canceled_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(3)
    customer_name = await bill_to_name_cell.text_content()
    
    # Return the customer name
    return customer_name.strip()
